text:
Anika: Heads-up — HarborQ onboarding: p95 token latency climbed from ~220ms to ~480ms over the last 6h. Behavior looks like KV-cache churn + occasional long-tail tokens. Suggest proactive changes: swap to INT8 (r-llama-13b-q8) + route 10% to fp16 fallback for safety, enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts, and run a 5% canary for 24h. @Raj @Diego any red flags? :eyes:

Raj: Yep saw the spike in the traces. KV cache miss rate ~27% for /generate. INT8 q8 expected benefits: ~35-50% token cost reduction, ~30-40% p95 improvement in similar workloads we've measured. Two requests: 1) per-route canary config, 2) soft timeout to trigger fallback before user sees huge latency. Proposed canary payload: ```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "model": "r-llama-13b-q8",
  "fallback": "r-llama-13b-fp16",
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "kv_cache_ttl_s": 3600
}
``` Also set soft timeout = 1500ms, hard timeout = 4000ms.

Diego: I'll sync with HarborQ PM and Ops. Booking a 30m enablement call tomorrow 09:00 PT to walk the plan and get a canonical prompt set for quality evals. Capturing the customer's SLO: p95 < 1s.

Maya: Add a short note to the Enablement docs about the quantized tradeoffs and sample prompt set. Quick cost estimate: rough token unit $0.0019 -> $0.0012 after q8 in their workload (est). I'll draft a short blurb + sample comparisons.

Anika: Nice — I'll kick off the canary once deploy infra is ready. @deploy-bot could you create the canary and share the rollout id? Also tagging @Raj for the retrain/eval checklist. :pray:

deploy-bot: Canary created — id rc-2026-0458. Route: /generate. Canary: 5% -> r-llama-13b-q8. Fallback: r-llama-13b-fp16. TTL KV cache 3600s. Soft timeout 1500ms. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/rc-2026-0458 :white_check_mark:

Diego: Perfect. Plan after canary: collect latency/cost/quality deltas at 6h, 24h, then decide to ramp to 50% if no regressions. I'll capture results in the enablement playbook and add to renewal health notes (good signal).

Anika: Thanks — I'll post a short summary into the CRM entry for HarborQ and ping the CS lead after 24h.

Maya: Will add the cost delta and sample evaluation screenshots to the onboarding folder.

Raj: One note: monitor for hallucination or jitter on long-context prompts — keep eval threshold on rouge/bleu/embedding-sim > 0.92.

Anika: Copy that. Launching canary now, will update thread with metrics. :rocket:
